## Lumentum (LITE) seen as a possible bargain despite strong AI datacom demand

A persistent valuation discount in a supplier of high-bandwidth optical interconnects — essential for AI data center scale-out — may represent a late-entry opportunity in the AI infra supply chain with less priced-in expectation than upstream chipmakers.

- LITE is characterized as potentially still undervalued even as AI data center demand for optical components remains strong
- 'Still' framing suggests the valuation gap has persisted through the AI buildout cycle rather than closing
- AI hyperscaler interconnect buildout is the implied end-market driver
- Medium confidence — valuation opinion, though AI datacom demand is a well-established LITE growth driver
